spec.task: Implement CONTRACTS/C1.md by changing only report_cli.py. Add --json to emit exactly one JSON object with exactly total, done, running, queued, blocked, next_queued; use the summarizer's highest-priority queued id or null if none. For tests/fixtures/jobs.json the parsed object must equal {"total":4,"done":1,"running":0,"queued":2,"blocked":1,"next_queued":"J-02"}. Successful JSON output exits 0 with no additional stdout. Invalid input must exit nonzero, print a short stderr message, and leave stdout empty. Preserve default text output and error behavior. Keep job_report.py byte-identical; do not modify tests/ or queue/NEXT.json, add dependencies, or write files at runtime (preserve bytecode suppression). Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_report_json.py tests/test_report_cli.py -q.
